duplicate_policy: Retain all paid slots and provenance; duplicates are not secretly replaced

program.name: gap_adjusted_efficiency
program.rationale: Balances reward per duration and continuously scaled contact-gap overhead against normalized conflict weight. Uses only base features, adding no graph operations; the overhead approximation can miss neighborhood overlap.
program.rule: weight / (1 + duration + max(station_gap, satellite_gap) * degree / (1 + degree)) - 0.25 * conflict_weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

program.name: cluster_adjusted_degree
program.rationale: Placeholder.
program.rule: weight

program.name: weighted_overlap_margin
program.rationale: Discounts raw conflict reward using pairwise minimum-weight overlap, retaining the strongest rival as a floor on estimated loss. The normalized margin uses active neighbors only; local edge enumeration can be quadratic in degree.
program.rule: (weight - max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight - 2 * neighbor_overlap_mass / max(1, degree))) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

program.name: greedy_neighbor_exchange
program.rationale: Subtracts one feasible packing of active conflicts from root reward, adding a small count-scaled root bonus. Neighborhood greedy work can exceed aggregate scans, and its packing can underestimate alternative reward.
program.rule: weight - neighbor_packing + 0.1 * weight / (1 + degree)

program.name: cover_normalized_pressure
program.rationale: Ranks root reward share against a cover-based estimate of competing neighborhood reward, with a dimensionless active-crowding penalty. Structural reach is local; cover construction may cost more than neighborhood aggregates.
program.rule: weight / (1 + weight + neighbor_cover) - 0.1 * degree / (1 + remaining_count)

program.name: packing_disagreement_rule
program.rationale: Uses cover-based loss when root reward exceeds the local cover; otherwise discounts optimistic greedy margins by estimator disagreement. Both active-neighborhood primitives are charged, making this a potentially expensive local candidate.
program.rule: (weight - neighbor_cover) / (1 + weight + neighbor_cover) if weight >= neighbor_cover else (weight - neighbor_packing) / (1 + weight + neighbor_packing) - 0.3 * max(0, neighbor_cover - neighbor_packing) / (1 + neighbor_cover)

program.name: compatible_peak_balance
program.rationale: Balances root reward against the strongest excluded rival and rewards preserving a strong compatible contact. Reaches the residual complement through a maximum scan; set construction and scanning are still paid per candidate.
program.rule: (weight - 0.4 * max_conflict_weight + 0.2 * compatible_peak) / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight + compatible_peak) - 0.1 * degree / (1 + remaining_count)

program.name: residual_completion_proxy
program.rationale: Scores a feasible greedy completion after including the root, normalized by total active reward, with a small local reward-share bonus. This reaches the global compatible residual; repeated greedy computation may dominate full-solve CPU.
program.rule: (weight + residual_packing) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight) + 0.05 * weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

program.name: degree_reward
program.rationale: Trades root reward against active conflict count. Uses native local information with no added feature computation; unequal rival weights and mutual conflicts remain unmodeled.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree)

program.name: turnaround_weight_pressure
program.rationale: Balances reward against aggregate active rival weight and continuous turnaround occupancy. Uses native root and neighborhood inputs without added features; summed rival weight can overstate competing opportunity.
program.rule: weight / (1 + conflict_weight / (1 + weight)) * (1 + duration) / (1 + duration + 0.25 * (station_gap + satellite_gap))

program.name: local_density_discount
program.rationale: Discounts aggregate rival pressure when active neighbors conflict among themselves, while retaining the strongest rival as a floor. Local induced-edge computation can be quadratic in active degree.
program.rule: weight / (1 + max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight / (1 + 2 * neighbor_edges / max(1, degree))) / (1 + weight))

program.name: weighted_overlap_margin
program.rationale: Uses weighted mutual exclusion among active rivals to estimate displaced reward, then scores a signed root margin with a small sparsity bonus. The approximation is local; weighted induced-edge work can be quadratic.
program.rule: weight - max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight / (1 + 2 * overlap_mass / (1 + conflict_weight))) + 0.05 * weight / (1 + degree)

program.name: local_greedy_switch
program.rationale: Separates favorable comparisons with a feasible packing of active rivals from normalized shortfalls. This local threshold is heuristic; constructing the greedy packing can be costly at high degree.
program.rule: weight / (1 + neighbor_pack) if weight >= neighbor_pack else (weight - neighbor_pack) / (1 + weight + neighbor_pack)

program.name: local_bound_caution
program.rationale: Scores a normalized margin against a neighborhood cover estimate and penalizes disagreement with feasible greedy packing. Its reach stays local, but computing both estimates may consume substantial time.
program.rule: (weight - neighbor_cover) / (1 + weight + neighbor_cover) - 0.1 * max(0, neighbor_cover - neighbor_pack) / (1 + neighbor_cover) + 0.05 * weight / ((1 + weight) * (1 + degree))

program.name: compatible_pair_lookahead
program.rationale: Combines root reward with its heaviest active compatible contact and subtracts average local rival pressure. This global two-contact horizon omits longer interactions and requires residual filtering and scanning per candidate.
program.rule: weight + compatible_peak - 0.25 * conflict_weight / (1 + degree)

program.name: residual_greedy_completion
program.rationale: Estimates completion reward by fixing the root and greedily packing the entire compatible active residual. This gives global structural reach, but repeated root-conditioned packing may dominate the full solve budget.
program.rule: weight + residual_pack

program.name: bounded_weighted_degree
program.rationale: Keeps conflict count dominant while adjusting for rival reward relative to the root. Uses native active-neighborhood aggregates with no added graph operations; mutual conflicts among rivals remain unmodeled.
program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.85 * degree + 0.15 * conflict_weight / (1 + weight))

program.name: continuous_turnaround_density
program.rationale: Scores reward per duration plus continuous turnaround overhead, subtracting a bounded conflict-count penalty. Uses only native inputs; occupancy efficiency can differ from displaced schedule reward and ignores rival overlap.
program.rule: weight / (1 + duration + 0.1 * (station_gap + satellite_gap)) - 0.12 * degree / (1 + degree)

program.name: peak_gated_pressure_blend
program.rationale: Uses count efficiency when the root matches or exceeds its strongest rival; otherwise blends in weighted competition. This root-local conditional adds no feature scans, but strongest-rival dominance does not establish an inclusion certificate.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) if weight >= max_conflict_weight else 0.9 * weight / (1 + degree) + 0.1 * weight * (1 + weight) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

program.name: capped_neighborhood_clustering
program.rationale: Discounts effective conflict count by at most fifteen percent when active rivals conflict among themselves. Reach stays within the root neighborhood; induced-edge enumeration can be quadratic, and clustering need not represent recoverable reward.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree * (1 - 0.15 * min(1, rival_mean_internal_degree / max(1, degree - 1))))

program.name: bounded_weighted_collision_priority
program.rationale: Scores root reward against weighted competition, applying a bounded discount for heavy mutually conflicting rivals while retaining the strongest-rival floor. Uses local weighted pair structure; quadratic edge work and imperfect overlap estimates may outweigh its usefulness.
program.rule: weight * (1 + weight) / (1 + weight + max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight / (1 + 0.25 * rival_pair_weight_fraction)))

program.name: cautious_packing_discount
program.rationale: Uses the fraction of local rival reward retained by a feasible packing to make a capped count discount, preserving ordinary count efficiency for sparse neighborhoods. Neighborhood greedy computation remains charged and can dominate CPU; the packing can underestimate alternatives.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) if degree <= 1 else weight / (1 + degree * (0.85 + 0.15 * min(1, max(0, rival_packing_fraction))))

program.name: active_dispersion_interpolation
program.rationale: Uses active mean reward relative to the active maximum to adjust the blend of count and weight-normalized pressure, retaining at least seventy-five percent count influence. Reaches the whole active set through aggregates; repeated linear scans may consume construction time.
program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.75 * degree + 0.25 * (active_weight_flatness * degree + (1 - active_weight_flatness) * conflict_weight / (1 + weight)))

program.name: bounded_compatible_peak_horizon
program.rationale: Adds a small bounded bonus for preserving a heavy compatible contact, moderated by the root's reward relative to its strongest rival. This reaches the global compatible residual through maximum scans; per-root filtering costs linear work and omits longer completion interactions.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.08 * compatible_peak_fraction * weight / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight))

program.name: relative_rival_degree
program.rationale: Retains reward per active conflict as the main signal and adds modest pressure from rivals weighted relative to the root. Native local aggregates add no feature computation; mutual exclusion among rivals remains unmodeled.
program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.85 * degree + 0.15 * conflict_weight / (1 + weight))

program.name: population_scaled_pressure
program.rationale: Blends active conflict count with rival reward measured in units of the current population's average reward. Native aggregates provide global scale without another residual scan; the average can obscure concentrated heavy rivals.
program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.65 * degree + 0.35 * conflict_weight * remaining_count / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight))

program.name: sufficient_exchange_priority
program.rationale: Prioritizes roots whose reward covers the sum of active rival rewards, then ranks other roots by reward share per conflict. This uses a conservative local exchange condition with no added graph work; its priority jump can affect search order.
program.rule: 1 + weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight) if weight >= conflict_weight else weight / ((1 + degree) * (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight))

program.name: bounded_turnaround_efficiency
program.rationale: Applies a bounded, continuous turnaround penalty to reward per active conflict. It uses only native root and neighborhood inputs; summed gaps approximate occupancy but cannot identify the resources shared with individual rivals.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 - 0.15 * degree / (1 + degree) * (station_gap + satellite_gap) / (1 + duration + station_gap + satellite_gap))

program.name: active_triangle_discount
program.rationale: Placeholder.
program.rule: weight

program.name: bounded_weighted_overlap_margin
program.rationale: Uses minimum-weight overlap among active rivals to discount displaced reward, with the strongest rival retained as a floor. The signed margin only moderately adjusts reward per conflict; local weighted edge enumeration can be quadratic in degree.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.2 * (weight - max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight / (1 + max(0, weighted_redundancy)))) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight))

program.name: bounded_neighbor_packing_pressure
program.rationale: Penalizes feasible rival packing beyond the strongest individual rival while preserving reward per conflict as the main signal. Reach is restricted to active neighbors; greedy packing and the maximum scan are paid per scored root and may dominate CPU.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 - 0.2 * max(0, independent_excess) / (1 + conflict_weight))

program.name: bounded_compatible_extrema
program.rationale: Modestly favors roots preserving a stronger compatible peak relative to their strongest conflicting rival. It reaches the full active complement through a maximum scan; repeated residual filtering costs CPU and the two extrema omit longer interactions.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.12 * (compatible_peak_ratio - max_conflict_weight / (1 + weight)) / (1 + compatible_peak_ratio + max_conflict_weight / (1 + weight)))

program.name: reward_first
program.rationale: Ranks direct reward as a transparent reference when conditional TRAIN preferences reverse. Structural reach is root-only; arithmetic is constant-size, but displacement is ignored.
program.rule: weight

program.name: reward_per_conflict
program.rationale: Balances reward against the number of blocked alternatives. Uses local degree with constant-size arithmetic; degree maintenance remains a kernel cost, and unequal neighbor weights are ignored.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree)

program.name: weighted_capture
program.rationale: Discounts reward by competing neighborhood weight while retaining reward scale. Uses local aggregate mass without additional traversal; aggregate maintenance costs remain, and mutually conflicting neighbors can exaggerate displacement.
program.rule: weight * (weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight))

program.name: strongest_exchange
program.rationale: Combines normalized margin over the strongest rival with a small neighborhood capture term. Reach is local and arithmetic is constant-size; several jointly feasible rivals can invalidate the single-rival proxy.
program.rule: (weight - max_conflict_weight) / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight) + 0.1 * weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

program.name: preserved_residual
program.rationale: Combines local reward capture, preserved compatible mass, and blocked count fraction using separate weight and count normalizations. Includes coarse global residual context without added scans; compatible mass does not establish mutual feasibility, and aggregate refresh retains its kernel cost.
program.rule: weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight) + 0.25 * compatible_weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight) - 0.1 * degree / (1 + remaining_count)

program.name: occupancy_efficiency
program.rationale: Ranks reward per approximate duration-plus-gap occupancy, discounted by the blocked residual fraction. Uses root resource values and degree context with constant-size arithmetic; overlapping gap effects make occupancy only a proxy.
program.rule: weight / (1 + duration + station_gap + satellite_gap) * (1 - degree / (1 + remaining_count))

program.name: density_adaptive
program.rationale: Continuously shifts from count efficiency toward weighted capture as the root blocks more of the active set. Uses local aggregates and residual size; arithmetic is constant-size, but neither component knows neighborhood topology and base refresh costs remain.
program.rule: (1 - degree / (1 + remaining_count)) * weight / (1 + degree) + degree / (1 + remaining_count) * weight * (weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight))

program.name: piecewise_exchange
program.rationale: Uses direct reward for isolates, exchange margin for single conflicts, and maximum-plus-average penalties for larger neighborhoods. Local count branches provide distinct repair behavior with constant-size arithmetic; missing neighbor compatibility limits the displacement estimate.
program.rule: weight if degree == 0 else (weight - max_conflict_weight if degree <= 1 else weight - 0.5 * max_conflict_weight - 0.5 * conflict_weight / (1 + degree))

program.name: closed_neighborhood_reward
program.rationale: Divides reward by closed-neighborhood size to favor contacts that preserve choices. Reach is the immediate unweighted neighborhood; arithmetic is constant cost, while supplied degree updates remain charged.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree)

program.name: weighted_conflict_share
program.rationale: Multiplies reward by its share of the weighted closed neighborhood, accounting for heterogeneous blockers. Reach is local conflict mass; arithmetic is constant cost, while maintaining that aggregate still requires active-set work.
program.rule: weight * (weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight))

program.name: strongest_rival_margin
program.rationale: Ranks a strongest-rival exchange margin with a discounted average of additional blocker mass. Reach is the immediate weighted neighborhood; constant arithmetic adds no graph traversal, but blocker compatibility remains unknown.
program.rule: weight - max_conflict_weight - 0.25 * max(0, conflict_weight - max_conflict_weight) / (1 + degree)

program.name: residual_fraction_balance
program.rationale: Balances reward against the fraction of active contacts blocked and adds a bounded compatible-weight bonus. Reach includes residual aggregate totals; arithmetic is constant cost, although those totals must track active-set changes.
program.rule: weight * (1 + compatible_weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight)) / (1 + 2 * degree / max(1, remaining_count - 1))

program.name: resource_reward_rate
program.rationale: Approximates reward per occupied resource time using duration and both actual root gaps. Reach is root-only, with constant arithmetic and no added graph work; the symmetric gap contribution is an occupancy proxy.
program.rule: weight / (1 + duration + 0.5 * (station_gap + satellite_gap))

program.name: bottleneck_gap_pressure
program.rationale: Combines a saturated duration benefit based on the larger resource gap with count and weighted conflict pressure. Reach covers root attributes and its neighborhood; arithmetic is constant cost, with ordinary conflict-summary update costs retained.
program.rule: weight * (1 + duration / (1 + duration + max(station_gap, satellite_gap))) / (1 + degree + 0.5 * conflict_weight / (1 + max_conflict_weight))

program.name: exchange_regime_switch
program.rationale: Handles isolated contacts directly, credits roots whose reward covers total blocker weight, and discounts contested roots otherwise. Reach is one neighborhood; bounded conditionals add constant arithmetic, with base updates still charged.
program.rule: weight if degree == 0 else (weight + 0.5 * (weight - conflict_weight) if weight >= conflict_weight else weight / (1 + degree + conflict_weight / (1 + weight)))

program.name: bounded_conflict_pivot
program.rationale: Adds bounded conflict-density and conflict-mass bonuses to reward, then penalizes the strongest rival. Reach includes residual summaries; arithmetic is constant cost, but aggregate updates remain charged and centrality can trade against greedy inclusion quality.
program.rule: weight * (1 + 0.5 * degree / max(1, remaining_count - 1) + 0.5 * conflict_weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight)) - 0.25 * max_conflict_weight

program.name: saturating_count_relief
program.rationale: Ranks reward per closed-neighborhood count with bounded relief for larger degrees. Reach is local count only; arithmetic is constant size and degree updates remain charged. Relief may overvalue heavily connected contacts.
program.rule: weight * (1 + 0.2 * degree / (1 + degree)) / (1 + degree)

program.name: blended_blocker_load
program.rationale: Blends blocker count with conflict weight normalized by root reward, preserving separate count and weight scales. Reach is the immediate neighborhood; constant-size arithmetic adds no features, but aggregate updates remain charged and blocker mass can overstate feasible displacement.
program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.8 * degree + 0.2 * conflict_weight / (1 + weight))

program.name: bounded_rival_correction
program.rationale: Uses count efficiency as the anchor and applies a small bounded correction for the strongest rival. Reach is local count and maximum weight; arithmetic is constant size, while maximum updates remain charged. Several feasible rivals can defeat the single-rival proxy.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.15 * (weight - max_conflict_weight) / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight))

program.name: residual_context_anchor
program.rationale: Perturbs count efficiency with bounded compatible-mass credit and blocked-count fraction. Reach includes coarse active-set summaries without new features; their updates remain charged. Compatible mass does not establish a mutually feasible residual schedule.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.12 * compatible_weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight) - 0.08 * degree / (1 + remaining_count))

program.name: tapered_resource_bonus
program.rationale: Adds a small saturated duration bonus relative to the larger actual resource gap while retaining count efficiency. Reach combines root resource attributes and local degree; arithmetic is constant size and degree updates remain charged. Gap occupancy is only approximate.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.1 * duration / (1 + duration + max(station_gap, satellite_gap)))

program.name: dominance_gated_pressure
program.rationale: Scores isolates directly, relaxes count pressure when reward covers total blocker weight, and adds normalized excess-mass pressure otherwise. Reach is one weighted neighborhood; constant-size conditionals retain summary-update costs. The dominance threshold can change rankings abruptly.
program.rule: weight if degree == 0 else (weight / (1 + 0.5 * degree) if weight >= conflict_weight else weight / (1 + degree + 0.2 * max(0, conflict_weight - weight) / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight)))

program.name: conservative_load_envelope
program.rationale: Discounts reward by the larger of actual blocker count and reward-normalized blocker mass. Reach is local count and aggregate weight; constant-size arithmetic adds no traversal, while active summaries remain charged. The conservative envelope may penalize mutually conflicting alternatives excessively.
program.rule: weight / (1 + max(degree, conflict_weight / (1 + weight)))

program.name: reward_with_gap_taper
program.rationale: Preserves absolute reward scale while applying a bounded discount for gap overhead relative to duration. Reach is root-only; arithmetic adds no graph traversal, though common kernel costs remain. It ignores displacement and treats overlapping resource gaps approximately.
program.rule: weight * (1 - 0.15 * (station_gap + satellite_gap) / (1 + duration + station_gap + satellite_gap))

program.name: soft_closed_neighborhood
program.rationale: Uses a smooth count penalty that returns direct reward for isolates and approaches reward per conflict for large neighborhoods. Reach is local degree; scalar arithmetic is cheap, while active degree maintenance remains charged and blocker weights are ignored.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree * (degree / (1 + degree)))

program.name: effective_blocker_blend
program.rationale: Blends blocker count with conflict mass measured in units of the larger root or rival weight. Reach is the immediate weighted neighborhood; fixed arithmetic adds no traversal, but summary maintenance remains charged and neighbor compatibility is unknown.
program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.75 * degree + 0.25 * conflict_weight / (1 + max(weight, max_conflict_weight)))

program.name: dominance_and_pressure
program.rationale: Softens the count penalty when root reward covers all blocker mass; otherwise uses the larger count or reward-relative mass pressure. Reach is one neighborhood, with fixed conditional arithmetic; aggregate maintenance remains charged and contested neighborhoods lack topology information.
program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.5 * degree) if weight >= conflict_weight else weight / (1 + max(degree, conflict_weight / (1 + weight)))

program.name: bounded_density_discount
program.rationale: Modestly softens count pressure when the root blocks a large fraction of the active set, retaining a positive denominator throughout. Reach combines local degree and residual size; arithmetic is fixed, but active count updates remain charged and density does not reveal neighbor connectivity.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree * (1 - 0.25 * min(1, degree / max(1, remaining_count - 1))))

program.name: residual_mean_contrast
program.rationale: Adjusts count efficiency by a bounded comparison between mean preserved weight and mean blocker weight, keeping counts and weights separately normalized. Reach includes coarse residual totals; repeated scalar arithmetic and aggregate maintenance cost time, and preserved contacts may conflict with each other.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.15 * (compatible_weight / max(1, remaining_count - degree - 1) - conflict_weight / max(1, degree)) / (1 + compatible_weight / max(1, remaining_count - degree - 1) + conflict_weight / max(1, degree)))

program.name: bounded_rival_adjustment
program.rationale: Applies a bounded strongest-rival margin correction to reward per blocked count, preserving reward units and positive scores. Reach is local degree and maximum rival weight; arithmetic is fixed, while summary refresh remains charged and several feasible rivals can defeat the exchange proxy.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.2 * (weight - max_conflict_weight) / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight))

program.name: reward_with_soft_occupancy
program.rationale: Retains reward scale with a modest bounded penalty for resource gap overhead relative to contact duration. Reach is root-only with few scalar operations; common-kernel work still applies, and the occupancy proxy ignores graph displacement.
program.rule: weight * (1 - 0.15 * max(station_gap, satellite_gap) / (1 + duration + max(station_gap, satellite_gap)))

program.name: capped_capture_envelope
program.rationale: Takes the larger count-efficiency or weighted-capture estimate, capped at twenty percent above count efficiency. Reach is local count and conflict mass; min/max arithmetic is fixed and summary maintenance remains charged, while optimistic capture can overvalue overlapping alternatives.
program.rule: min(1.2 * weight / (1 + degree), max(weight / (1 + degree), weight * (weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight))))

program.name: cheap_displacement_density
program.rationale: Balances blocked contact count and blocked reward relative to root reward. No additional graph computation is required; this pointwise candidate cannot represent the certified structural reversal.
program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.5 * degree + 0.5 * conflict_weight / (1 + weight))

program.name: cheap_gap_aware_regret
program.rationale: Uses strongest-neighbor regret for tiny neighborhoods and a smoother crowding penalty otherwise, scaled by actual gap-to-duration cost. It adds no features but remains blind to remote interactions.
program.rule: (weight - max_conflict_weight if degree <= 1 else weight / (1 + 0.25 * degree) - 0.25 * conflict_weight / (1 + degree)) / (1 + (station_gap + satellite_gap) / (1 + duration))

program.name: local_redundancy_discount
program.rationale: Discounts redundant blocked reward when competing neighbors conflict with one another, retaining a strongest-neighbor floor. Active one-hop edge enumeration can be quadratic in degree and cannot resolve the saved remote witness.
program.rule: weight / (1 + max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight - 2 * neighbor_edge_mass / max(1, degree)) / (1 + weight))

program.name: local_greedy_exchange
program.rationale: Estimates independently packable neighbor reward and scores a normalized exchange margin with a small crowding term. Reach is one hop; repeated greedy computations can be costly in dense neighborhoods.
program.rule: (weight - neighbor_greedy) / (1 + weight + neighbor_greedy) + 0.1 * weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

program.name: local_exchange_confidence
program.rationale: Prioritizes roots whose reward covers the neighbor independent-set upper bound; otherwise it uses greedy exchange value with an uncertainty penalty. Both computations remain local, may be expensive, and do not capture the witnessed distant changes.
program.rule: 1 + (weight - neighbor_cover) / (1 + weight + neighbor_cover) if weight >= neighbor_cover else (weight - neighbor_greedy - 0.25 * max(0, neighbor_cover - neighbor_greedy)) / (1 + weight + neighbor_cover)

program.name: global_greedy_marginal
program.rationale: Compares greedy root-included and root-excluded completion estimates using a root-scale normalized margin. This reaches remote residual structure; two global greedy computations per candidate may dominate total CPU, and their difference is approximate.
program.rule: (weight + take_greedy - skip_greedy) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight / (1 + degree)) + 0.05 * weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

program.name: global_completion_bound_blend
program.rationale: Ranks root-included completions using mostly greedy reward, limited optimism from cover slack, and a mean-conflict penalty. Reach is global; repeated residual greedy and cover computations are expensive, and slack need not predict final schedule quality.
program.rule: weight + residual_greedy + 0.2 * max(0, residual_cover - residual_greedy) - 0.1 * conflict_weight / (1 + degree)

program.name: global_residual_pressure
program.rationale: Approximates retained packing reward from residual edge count and pair-weight pressure, normalizing count and reward scales separately. Global residual edge enumeration may be quadratic, and aggregate pressure can miss arrangement-dependent effects.
program.rule: weight + compatible_weight / (1 + residual_edge_count / max(1, remaining_count - degree - 1) + residual_edge_product / (1 + compatible_weight * compatible_weight / max(1, remaining_count - degree - 1)))

program.name: cheap_density_blend
program.rationale: Blends reward per conflict with a small heaviest-conflict margin. Uses only base9 inputs with no added graph computation; its pointwise information cannot resolve the witnessed reversal.
program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.25 * max(0, degree)) + 0.1 * (weight - max_conflict_weight) / (1 + max(0, degree))

program.name: cheap_pressure_gate
program.rationale: A generic comparison with the heaviest conflict switches between net reward and penalized density. This inexpensive conditional candidate uses immediate aggregates and retains the nonlocal representation limitation.
program.rule: (weight - 0.35 * max_conflict_weight - 0.1 * conflict_weight / (1 + max(0, degree))) if weight >= max_conflict_weight else (weight / (1 + 0.15 * max(0, degree)) - 0.45 * (max_conflict_weight - weight))

program.name: local_pair_opportunity
program.rationale: Penalizes jointly collectible conflicts using a weighted edge-deletion lower bound and the heaviest neighbor. Reach is limited to active one-hop neighbors, so the distant cycle remains unresolved; neighbor edge construction can be quadratic in degree.
program.rule: weight - 0.5 * max(max_conflict_weight, neighbor_pair_floor) + 0.08 * weight / (1 + max(0, degree))

program.name: local_collectible_ratio
program.rationale: Normalizes reward by a blend of feasible greedy and cover estimates of collectible neighboring weight, with a small duration-efficiency term. Both estimates remain one-hop and cannot distinguish the saved nonlocal witness; dense neighborhoods may make these local algorithms costly.
program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.75 * max(0, neighbor_greedy_weight) + 0.25 * max(0, neighbor_cover_weight)) + 0.05 * weight / (1 + max(0, duration))

program.name: residual_moment_continuation
program.rationale: Compresses compatible weight by normalized weighted conflict load in the root-conditioned residual to approximate continuation value. It observes edges beyond one hop, although this aggregate need not resolve the witness; inducing the full residual can be quadratic.
program.rule: weight + compatible_weight / (1 + 2 * max(0, residual_pair_pressure)) - 0.05 * conflict_weight / (1 + max(0, degree))

program.name: global_cover_displacement
program.rationale: Estimates displaced opportunity by comparing covers after excluding only the root and after removing its closed neighborhood. Full active-graph partitions can respond to distant changes, but their difference is heuristic and two global cover computations may dominate runtime.
program.rule: weight - max(0, cover_displacement) + 0.1 * weight / (1 + max(0, degree))

program.name: global_greedy_continuation
program.rationale: Ranks immediate reward plus a deterministic feasible greedy continuation over surviving compatible contacts. Root conditioning supplies nonlocal structure, but repeated global greedy passes can dominate the complete solve and witness repair is unverified.
program.rule: weight + compatible_greedy_weight + 0.02 * weight / (1 + max(0, degree))

program.name: global_continuation_uncertainty
program.rationale: Adds greedy continuation value and penalizes the cover-versus-greedy gap per surviving vertex, favoring more tightly estimated continuations. Both algorithms reach the full root-conditioned residual; their CPU cost can be substantial and the gap supplies only a ranking cue.
program.rule: weight + residual_greedy_weight - 0.4 * max(0, residual_cover_weight - residual_greedy_weight) / (1 + max(0, remaining_count - degree - 1))

program.name: sparsity_with_bounded_rival_margin
program.rationale: Combines reward per blocked contact with a bounded strongest-rival correction. Immediate aggregates require no added graph work and cannot distinguish the remote witness.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.12 * (weight - max_conflict_weight) / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight))

program.name: small_residual_margin_and_mild_gap_cost
program.rationale: Uses relative rival regret in residuals containing at most two contacts, then weighted sparsity with a mild normalized gap discount. Base9 computation is inexpensive but remains pointwise.
program.rule: (weight - max_conflict_weight) / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight) if remaining_count <= 2 else weight / (1 + degree) * (1 - 0.08 * (station_gap + satellite_gap) / (1 + duration + station_gap + satellite_gap))

program.name: count_priority_with_mean_conflict_regret
program.rationale: Prioritizes fewer blocked contacts and resolves equal counts using bounded reward versus mean-conflict regret. Count and reward scales remain separate; there is no added graph computation or remote structural information.
program.rule: -degree + 0.5 * (weight - conflict_weight / (1 + degree)) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight / (1 + degree))

program.name: neighbor_packing_adjusted_sparsity
program.rationale: Blends conflict count with independently packable neighbor reward expressed in strongest-neighbor units. Reach is active one-hop structure; repeated greedy work can grow with degree and cannot repair the saved remote distinction.
program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.8 * degree + 0.2 * neighbor_pack_units)

program.name: bounded_neighbor_redundancy_discount
program.rationale: Gives a limited count discount when active competitors conflict with each other, plus a small relative-reward adjustment. One-hop density cannot resolve the witness; neighbor-edge enumeration may be quadratic in degree.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree * (1 - 0.15 * neighbor_edge_density)) * (1 + 0.05 * weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight))

program.name: bounded_global_packability_bonus
program.rationale: Applies a bounded bonus for the fraction of surviving compatible reward collected by greedy packing. Root-conditioned global reach can expose remote arrangement changes, but every candidate still incurs a full residual greedy pass.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.2 * residual_pack_fraction)

program.name: bounded_residual_pressure_bonus
program.rationale: Normalizes surviving pair-weight pressure by total reward times strongest reward and mildly favors less congested continuations. It reaches beyond the neighborhood, but aggregates lose arrangement detail and full residual edge enumeration may be quadratic.
program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.7 * degree + 0.3 * conflict_weight / (1 + weight)) * (1 + 0.15 / (1 + residual_pair_pressure))

program.name: repair_focused_global_exchange
program.rationale: Uses a root-scale greedy inclusion margin when the closed neighborhood occupies a substantial active-set fraction, and a bounded sparsity correction otherwise. Global structure supplies missing distinctions; the score gate does not save computation, and two residual greedy passes remain costly.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.1 * greedy_exchange / (1 + abs(greedy_exchange))) if remaining_count > 8 * (1 + degree) else greedy_exchange + 0.05 * weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

program.name: degree_first_bounded_reward
program.rationale: Keeps degree ordering primary, using bounded reward and conflict terms within each degree class. Requires no added graph computation, but cannot represent the certified nonlocal reversal.
program.rule: -degree + 0.4 * weight / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight) - 0.1 * conflict_weight / ((1 + degree) * (1 + weight + conflict_weight))

program.name: mean_conflict_density
program.rationale: Adjusts reward per blocked contact by a bounded comparison with mean conflicting reward, keeping count and weight scales separate. Uses only base inputs and remains blind to remote edge rearrangements.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.15 * (weight - conflict_weight / max(1, degree)) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight / max(1, degree)))

program.name: tempered_neighbor_clustering
program.rationale: Uses only base density as a cost-aware candidate; no added feature is evaluated because the declared constant is unused. Its pointwise information cannot repair the witnessed reversal.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.08 * (weight - max_conflict_weight) / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight))

program.name: retained_peak_continuation
program.rationale: Uses compatible reward concentration through base aggregates as a cheap continuation approximation. The unused constant incurs no score-slice work, but this approximation cannot distinguish the remote witness.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) + 0.06 * weight * compatible_weight / ((1 + compatible_weight) * (1 + remaining_count))

program.name: bounded_residual_packability
program.rationale: Modulates degree density by a bounded feasible packing fraction of the full root-compatible residual. It observes remote structure, but a global greedy pass and weight scan remain charged and may dominate runtime; witness repair is unverified.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.2 * min(1, max(0, retained_pack_fraction)))

program.name: damped_cover_displacement
program.rationale: Uses root-conditioned cover displacement as a bounded correction to degree density. Global partitions can respond to remote arrangement changes, but heuristic cover differences can be unstable and two global cover computations may dominate the budget.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.12 * (weight - cover_displacement) / (1 + weight + abs(cover_displacement)))

program.name: crowding_scaled_greedy_exchange
program.rationale: Adds a normalized take-versus-skip greedy margin, with decision strength scaled by the fraction of active contacts blocked by the root. Reach is global; this scaling limits influence on large sparse sets but does not avoid either charged greedy computation.
program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) + 0.5 * weight * (1 + degree) / (1 + remaining_count) * greedy_exchange / (1 + weight + abs(greedy_exchange))

program.name: conservative_completion_gate
program.rationale: Compares a greedy root-included completion with a cover bound for excluding the root. A nonnegative margin relaxes crowding; otherwise a capped penalty retains density ranking. Both global operations remain charged regardless of the rule branch, and schedule benefit is unverified.
program.rule: weight / (1 + 0.5 * degree) if completion_margin >= 0 else weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.1 * completion_margin / (1 + weight + abs(completion_margin)))
